reviews.title: Price is worth it and looks just as good as it's built
reviews.comment: Installed this on my AIO cooler (water cooled cpu) by ARCTIC as one fan was starting to make noise randomly. It has worked great and it actually runs quieter than the good OEM Arctic fan next to it. Cools as expected and feels about the same as the Actic neighbor too. Overall, happy with this and I feel it's close enough to the Noctua brands as I have one of those also installed nearby on the same tower. Price is worth it and looks just as good as it's built. Length of cable was maybe too much for the AIO, but happy to have more than not enough.

I couldn’t be happier with the **be quiet! Pure Wings 3 120mm Quiet PWM Case Fan**! This fan is an absolute game-changer when it comes to cooling performance and noise levels. It runs incredibly quietly—even at high speeds—making it perfect for a silent PC build or router build.

I highly recommend it to anyone who values silence and efficiency in their PC or router setup!

reviews.title: Great fan for open intake/exhaust
reviews.comment:
To start, I ordered this fan to replace the stock ibuypower rgb exhaust fan. From testing and data collected from other manufacturers this fan is one of the best in terms of non restrictive air transfer while being slightly underwhelming in terms of static pressure. This means it is perfect for an exhaust fan without any mesh or radiator to push through.
Operation is nearly silent at full rpm and I have this fan’s curve set much more aggressively being the only exhaust fan & I never notice it changing rpm. Sound is more of a whoosh than a hum like other fans similar in the way noctua fans are. This is most likely from the fins on the blades and the difference between this fan and my previous ibuypower branded fan is night and day.
Bonus points for having a black and white logo on the intake side of the fan Be quiet!! Previous fan offerings have all been orange and subjectively unsightly in an all black setup like the one I have.
Overall I ended up just getting one of these for the exhaust, and arctic p12s for intake as I use a push pull on my radiator making the static pressure a must have.
